overview_description.description:
Company overview
BusinessBOX is a one-stop advisory firm… We decided to start our adventure to provide entrepreneurs smartly tailored business services in the fields of Business and Financial Advisory; Branding & Design; Marketing; Digital Transformation and Training.

Our advisory firm’s name is a visualization of our Raison D’Etre. We envision handing our clients an empty box in which they can throw their burdens and send it back to us. We then unload and refill it with beautiful hand crafted solutions. Allowing our clients to focus on their core business To reach their full potential activities.

The blue shade in the logo reflects the trust our clients place in us. The yellow is inspired by our optimism to bring positive change to our clients. With attention to balance and objectivity that are signified by the gray color.

Our vision
Striving to reset the standards of simplicity and efficiency in the business services industry

Our purpose
To serve businesses in a way that allows them to devote more of their time, resources and effort on what they do best
